statement.name: getMessagesForApplication
statement.sql:
select distinct cast(a.MessageId as varchar(36)),a.subject, cast(a.ThreadId as varchar(36)),a.SenderId,a.MessageDate, a.Attachments,a.ThreadLevel,b.ReceiptToList from mail_message as a inner join Mail_messageLog as b on a.messageid=b.messageid inner join Mail_Message_Context as c on a.messageid=c.messageid
11
order by
